pick.headline: Croatians vote for independence in a referendum
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of May 20, 1991, carried a Yugoslav commentary noting Croatia's referendum 'today' as a step toward dissociation and warning that the army, now at combat readiness, would not sit idle.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: East Europe, No. 097, 20 May 1991
evidence.snippet: …d also bear in mind that shortly before 15 May Stipe Mesic said that Croatia would immediately initiate the process of dissociation if he was not elected president of the SFRY Presidency YUGOSLAVIA 39 Considering that a referendum is being held in Croatia today, one should see it as one of the preliminary things for what Mesic had announced.
